unlisted_practices: Conduct health technology assessments of AI algorithms' costs and benefits before adoption, since incremental advantages may not justify implementation and maintenance costs.
Pair AI algorithms with dedicated infrastructure, resources, and personnel trained to act on their predictions.
Researchers and journals should prioritize studies that evaluate clinically relevant patient outcomes.

screen.reason: This is an editorial commenting on a previously published study (COMPOSER sepsis prediction model) and discussing best practices/recommendations for clinical implementation, continuous monitoring, and infrastructure for AI tools.
